binding: MPI/environment defaults; no explicit binding or oversubscription requested
scope: maximum rank-local time of all stages in the stepping loop; excludes launch, setup, gather, serial validation and output
protocol: one excluded warmup per case; five measurements by default, rotating case order; medians of job maxima
interpretation: speedup uses the same method and grid at P=1; grids have equal K*M but different dt and physical final time
limitations: Shared local environment; CPU exclusivity not guaranteed; not a cluster benchmark
